recommendations.title: Microdochium patch risk is high
recommendations.message: Modelled risk is 3/4 — temperature and recent rainfall/leaf wetness both favour the UK's most common turf disease. Check closely for small, orange-brown patches, especially in shaded or slow-draining areas, and consider a preventative fungicide or cultural intervention (brushing off dew, improving airflow).

recommendations.title: Dollar spot risk is building
recommendations.message: Modelled risk is 19%, approaching the 20% threshold. Reduce leaf wetness duration where you can (mow or brush off dew early, avoid evening irrigation) and monitor daily.

recommendations.title: Water balance is in a healthy range
recommendations.message: 7-day net balance is +2mm — no irrigation action needed today.

recommendations.title: Good window for overseeding
recommendations.message: Soil temperature is 14.4°C, within the germination range for most cool-season UK turf species, and topsoil moisture looks workable. Favourable conditions if renovation is on the plan.

recommendations.title: Conditions suit spraying today
recommendations.message: Wind is forecast at up to 12 km/h, within the typical safe spraying range. Always confirm against the product label and LERAP/buffer-zone requirements.
